claims.text: Indicated in TB w closed-space infections such as meningitis, when inflam = a major cause of morbidity
claims.quote: Glucocorticoids are sometimes used as part of TB management when inflammation is a major cause of morbidity and are indicated for patients with acute respiratory failure (31) or with closed-space infections, such as meningitis (32)

claims.text: Dexamethasone 12 mg PO or IV every 6 h for pts >25 kg; children <25 kg get 8 mg; continued for 2 to 3 wks
claims.quote: Dexamethasone 12 mg orally or IV every 6 hours is given to patients > 25 kg; children < 25 kg are given 8 mg. Treatment is continued for 2 to 3 weeks.

claims.text: ATS/CDC/IDSA: initial adjunctive dexamethasone or prednisolone, tapered over 6–8 wks (strong rec).
claims.quote: We recommend initial adjunctive corticosteroid therapy with dexamethasone or prednisolone tapered over 6–8 weeks for patients with tuberculous meningitis (strong recommendation; moderate certainty in the evidence)
claims.locator: Nahid P, et al. Official ATS/CDC/IDSA Clinical Practice Guidelines: Treatment of Drug-Susceptible Tuberculosis. Clin Infect Dis 2016;63(7):e147-e195
